ambiguities_or_notes: Recovery reconstruction: the pinned Russian source identity is preserved, while wording and apparatus were checked against the official 90-volume edition because the audited Russian ZIP is not byte-mountable in this runtime.
The manuscript's two variants remain separate and all three editorial notes are translated.
Two illegible manuscript spans are preserved explicitly rather than conjecturally supplied.
The philosophical terms я / не я are rendered conservatively as I / not-I; limited/unlimited, activity/inactivity, and consciousness are kept recurrent rather than stylistically varied.
The grammatically unstable marginal sentence corresponding to 'Причина этого есть деятельность есть противуречие' is deliberately left unstable in English rather than silently rationalized.

The exact page-marker sequence 226, 227, 228 is preserved; placement within the reconstructed English follows the official pagination and must be rechecked once the exact audited Markdown bytes are mountable.
